exposure: 25-gauge pencil point needle for spinal anesthesia
outcome: Incidence of adverse events (specifically post-dural puncture headache)
cohort: 200 women with full-term labor undergoing emergency cesarean section.
finding: While a 22G cutting needle was faster for spinal puncture in cases of difficult landmark palpation, the difference was minimal, and considering the potential for higher PDPH incidence with larger needles, a 25G pencil point needle may be a better choice for spinal anesthesia in emergency cesarean sections.
